sources.title: MCP official server tools specification
sources.scope: Protocol operation schemas and discovery; not a health terminology.

sources.title: OpenAPI Specification 3.1.1
sources.scope: Versioned API schema reference, not a claim about the newest OpenAPI release.

sources.title: USDA FoodData Central Foundation Foods documentation
sources.scope: Component forms, reporting bases, unavailable nutrients, analytical method distinctions.

sources.title: USDA National Agricultural Library: nutrient lists, SR Legacy 2018
sources.scope: Additional food-component and amino-acid coverage. Historical version, not a live food-data integration.

sources.title: FAO/INFOODS food component identifiers
sources.scope: Precisely distinguish components and expression bases; no unverified tag mappings are required.

sources.title: FDA industry resources for Nutrition Facts labels
sources.scope: Label nutrient families, soluble/insoluble fibre and sugar-alcohol fields; not a labeling-compliance implementation.

sources.title: NIH Office of Dietary Supplements: Folate, health professional
sources.scope: Folate forms and DFE are not identical quantities.

sources.title: NIH Office of Dietary Supplements: Vitamin A, health professional
sources.scope: Retinol activity equivalents and carotenoid forms.

sources.title: NIH Office of Dietary Supplements: Vitamin E, health professional
sources.scope: Form-specific vitamin E expression; no generic IU-to-mass conversion.

sources.title: ICMR-NIN achievements: Indian Food Composition Tables 2017 description
sources.scope: Indian-context coverage cross-check. The official descriptive page was reviewed; the full IFCT book was not reviewed.

sources.title: Dr Lal PathLabs official comprehensive dummy report WM17S
sources.scope: Selected report pages visually reviewed: chemistry, vitamin tests, HbA1c/eAG, CBC, revised-report notation. No patient values copied.

sources.title: Labcorp comprehensive metabolic panel: test description and sample report
sources.scope: Panel constituents and reporting conventions; sample first page visually reviewed at https://files.labcorp.com/testmenu-d8/sample_reports/322000.pdf.

sources.title: Labcorp comprehensive pre-bariatric profile: test description and sample report
sources.scope: Broader nutritional/laboratory fields; sample first two pages visually reviewed at https://files.labcorp.com/testmenu-d8/sample_reports/259141.pdf. Not a recommendation to order that profile.

sources.title: Mayo Clinic Laboratories thyroid function cascade
sources.scope: Distinct thyroid assays and an official sample report; source sample page visually reviewed.

sources.title: HL7 FHIR R4 Observation
sources.scope: Design reference for result variants, absence reasons, components and reference-range context. This service is not a FHIR server.

sources.title: HL7 FHIR R4 DiagnosticReport
sources.scope: Report grouping, result status and effective versus issued dates; no document-storage feature.

sources.title: LOINC users guide: major parts of a term
sources.scope: Analyte/property/time/specimen/scale/method distinctions. Do not publish guessed clinical codes.

sources.title: UCUM specification
sources.scope: Unit representation and dimensional meaning; assay equivalence must be checked separately.

sources.title: International Diabetes Center: AGP report examples
sources.scope: Interval-based glucose summaries and coverage metadata. Displayed clinical targets are not adopted as application targets.

sources.title: American Thoracic Society: interpreting sleep studies primer
sources.scope: Sleep-study result families, respiratory indices and oxygen reporting; no diagnostic thresholds adopted.

sources.title: InBody official result-sheet explanation
sources.scope: Segmental composition and source-specific body-composition quantities; no vendor score or target claims adopted.

sources.title: Garmin official running-dynamics manual
sources.scope: Running-dynamics measurement families. No wearable integration is required.

sources.title: HL7 FHIR R4 MedicationAdministration
sources.scope: Actual administration period, route, dose, site and rate; no prescription planning.

sources.title: Labcorp coagulation/DIC profile
sources.scope: Coagulation analyte family coverage, not a screening recommendation.

sources.title: Mayo Clinic Laboratories HEp-2 antinuclear antibodies
sources.scope: Antibody result forms, titers and patterns.

sources.title: Labcorp gastrointestinal stool PCR profile
sources.scope: Organism-specific qualitative molecular results.

sources.title: Labcorp quantitative fecal fat
sources.scope: Collection duration and excretion-rate versus concentration distinctions.

sources.title: USDA National Agricultural Library: food composition
sources.scope: Specialized food-component families, including choline, isoflavones and purines.

sources.title: ATS/ERS Standardization of Spirometry, 2019 technical statement
sources.scope: Primary technical statement for spirometry measurement/report structure, not a diagnostic implementation.

sources.title: International Society for Clinical Densitometry: official adult positions
sources.scope: DXA site, BMD, T-score/Z-score and report comparability; no clinical thresholds implemented.

sources.title: Mayo Clinic Laboratories semen analysis with strict morphology
sources.scope: Semen quantity, motility and morphology are different reported measurements.

sources.title: Labcorp cancer antigen CA 125 test definition
sources.scope: Assay-specific tumor-marker result identity; inclusion is not a recommendation for screening.
